topic: Learning the Rules at the Dog Park

script.title: FIRST DAY AT THE DOG PARK
script.scene_zh: 狗狗公園 · 學習規則
script.story_hook: A new dog dad meets a park regular.
script.intro_zh: 新手飼主在門口，遇上公園老常客。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the park edition! Today we're learning dog park rules.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎收看公園篇！今天要來認識狗狗公園的規矩。
script.outro: That's how a first day goes! See you at the next one, bye.
script.outro_zh: 第一天的冒險就是這樣！下一集我們再見，拜拜。
script.practice_intro_en: Follow me now and echo each line back.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在請跟著我，一句一句大聲重複。

script.youtube_title_en: "Is This Where We Let Dogs Off Leash?" — Learning the Dog Park Rules
script.youtube_description:
第一次帶狗狗進公園，牽繩到底在哪裡解開？大狗小狗要分流、餵零食要先問、地上水管要小心——跟著新手飼主 Marcus 和資深常客 Peggy，邊玩邊學最道地的公園英文！整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就懂規則。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
First trip to the dog park and you're not sure where the leash comes off? Follow Marcus and seasoned regular Peggy through the double gate, the small-dog side, treat etiquette, and the water hose — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and go play with confidence.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🐕狗狗公園規則英文｜鬆開牽繩・大小分區・餵食前先問｜聽完就懂規矩｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次帶狗狗進公園，牽繩到底能不能解開？
大狗小狗要分開嗎？零食可以隨身帶嗎？

這一集帶大家走進午後熱鬧的狗狗公園，跟著新手飼主 Marcus 從第二道門鬆開牽繩、把十一磅的小狗導向正確的邊，到問清零食禮貌與水管位置，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🐾 入園第一步：例如「Is this where we let dogs off leash?」。
🚰 設施與安全：例如「Heads up though, small dogs use the right.」。
🦴 相處小禮節：例如「Sure, but ask first — some dogs have allergies.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

帶你家小狗出門那天，這十八句會幫你安心又快樂！
script.thumbnail_action: unclipping a leash at the second gate

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! Is this where we let dogs off leash?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs wɛr wi lɛt dɔɡz ɔf liʃ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！這裡就是讓狗狗鬆開牽繩的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, once you're through the second gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp wʌns jʊr θru ðə ˈsɛkənd ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，過了第二道門就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, two gates? I totally missed that sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ tu ɡeɪts aɪ ˈtoʊtəli mɪst ðæt saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 兩道門？我完全沒看到那個牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone does! That first gate is a safety buffer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriwʌn dʌz ðæt fɜrst ɡeɪt ɪz ə ˈseɪfti ˈbʌfər/
dialogue.zh: 大家都一樣啦！第一道門是安全緩衝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. He's super friendly, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tu noʊ hɪz ˈsupər ˈfrɛndli aɪ ˈprɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 學到了。牠超級親人，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I bet! Heads up though, small dogs use the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɛt hɛdz ʌp ðoʊ smɔl dɔɡz juz ðə raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我相信！不過要注意——小狗都走右邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, he's tiny, eleven pounds. So that side.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hiz ˈtaɪni ɪˈlɛvən paʊndz soʊ ðæt saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對，牠很小，只有十一磅，該走那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Water fountains are on both sides, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈwɔtər ˈfaʊntənz ɑr ɑn bɔθ saɪdz tu/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。兩邊都設有飲水台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Am I allowed to bring dog treats?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɛkt æm aɪ əˈlaʊəd tə brɪŋ dɔɡ trits/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我可以帶狗狗零食嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but ask first — some dogs have allergies.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr bət æsk fɜrst səm dɔɡz hæv əˈlɜrdʒiz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過要記得先問——有些狗會過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Oh — is that blue ball his? Sorry!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt oʊ ɪz ðæt blu bɔl hiz ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 了解。喔——那顆藍色的球是牠的嗎？抱歉！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Haha, take it — he's stolen ten balls this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑhɑ teɪk ɪt hiz ˈstoʊən tɛn bɔlz ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，送牠吧——這週牠已經偷走十顆球了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, at least he's popular here, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ət list hiz ˈpɑpjələr hɪr raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，至少牠在這裡很受歡迎，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Popular? Maybe! One more thing — watch the water hose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑpjələr ˈmeɪbi wʌn mɔr θɪŋ wɑtʃ ðə ˈwɔtər hoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎嗎？也許吧！還有——小心那條水管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the tips, first day's a lot, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔr ðə tɪps fɜrst deɪz ə lɑt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的提醒，第一天的資訊真的超多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're doing great — he fits right in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈduɪŋ ɡreɪt hi fɪts raɪt ɪn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你帶得很好——牠一下子就融進來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome. Same time next Saturday, maybe?
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。下週六同一時間，怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll see us! Take it slow, bye, you two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul si ʌs teɪk ɪt sloʊ baɪ ju tu/
dialogue.zh: 你一定會再見到我們！慢慢來，你們兩個再見啦。
